about: Jamarion Sharp is listed 7-5, taller than Wembanyama's listed 7-4, yet he has never played an NBA game that counts: Dallas cut him twice, the Clippers once, and Toronto gave him a camp deal on Oct 12. The knock is offense: Wemby took 350 threes last season; Sharp, in the G League, took 0.
